audit_items.proof_trace: Neither the authorization grant path (handleConsent) nor the token issuance path (POST /oauth/token) writes any persistent audit log entry; only ephemeral console.log debug output is produced. The create_user_consent RPC records functional consent state but is not an audit log, and the token endpoint leaves zero DB writes after deleting the used auth code. No audit_log table or security event logger exists anywhere in src/.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker with a stolen client_secret calls POST /oauth/token to exchange authorization codes for access tokens; the auth code is deleted and no audit record is created, leaving no forensic trail of the token issuance for incident response or anomaly detection.
